mapper.insert: insert into agent_session (session_id, user_id, title, status, last_task_id, message_count, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{lastTaskId}, #{messageCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update agent_session set message_count = message_count + 1, last_task_id = #{lastTaskId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update agent_session set status = 3, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
